description: Do minimum runtime retry settings change how B's conflicting edit returns? The DAO type library is described first (for SetOptionEnum), then DBEngine.SetOption(57 = dbLockRetry, 1) and SetOption(63 = dbLockDelay, 1) before opening. Owner A = Workspaces(0) with DBEngine.OpenDatabase(A, writable); owner B = DBEngine.CreateWorkspace('second', dbUseJet) with its own OpenDatabase(A, writable); one STA. A: BeginTrans; UPDATE T SET V = 9 WHERE ID = 1. B: BeginTrans; UPDATE T SET V = 101 WHERE ID = 1; db2.RecordsAffected; DBEngine.Errors. A CommitTrans; B CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors; read T through each owner; close both; read T through a fresh Workspace. Statements use dbFailOnError.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
